spec.title: Close Failed Count
spec.description: Number of failed region close operations.

spec.title: RIT Count
spec.description: Number of regions currently in transition (e.g., being moved, split, or merged).

spec.title: RIT Duration P75
spec.description: 75th percentile of the duration for regions in transition (in milliseconds).

spec.title: RIT Duration P99
spec.description: 99th percentile of the duration for regions in transition (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Move Time P95
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time taken to move a region between RegionServers (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Split Time Max
spec.description: Maximum time taken to split a region (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Unassign Time P90
spec.description: 90th percentile of the time taken to unassign a region (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Master Status
spec.description: Indicates whether the HBase Master is up (1) or down (0).

spec.title: Process Call Time Min
spec.description: Minimum time taken to process an IPC call (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Process Call Time P98
spec.description: 98th percentile of the time taken to process an IPC call (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Observed  IPC Calls Queued/sec
spec.description: Number of IPC calls currently queued per sec .

spec.title: Observed IPC Responses/sec
spec.description: Number of IPC responses processed by the HBase Master per second.

spec.title: HLog Split Time Min
spec.description: Minimum time taken to split an HLog file (in milliseconds).

spec.title: HLog Split Time P95
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time taken to split an HLog file (in milliseconds).

spec.title: HLog Split Size Max
spec.description: Maximum size of an HLog file during split operations (in bytes).

spec.title: Live RegionServers
spec.description: Number of active RegionServers currently connected to the HBase Master.

spec.title: Balancer Execution Time (Max)
spec.description: Maximum time taken by the HBase Balancer to compute and execute a cluster balancing operation. High values may indicate region distribution inefficiencies or large cluster rebalancing activities

spec.title: Balancer Cluster P99.9
spec.description: 99.9th percentile of the time taken by the balancer to rebalance the cluster (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Balancer Runs/sec
spec.description: Number of HBase Balancer executions per second. The balancer periodically redistributes regions across RegionServers to maintain an even cluster load.

spec.title: Server Crash Time P75
spec.description: 75th percentile of the time taken to handle a server crash (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Dead RegionServers
spec.description: Number of RegionServers that are dead or unresponsive.

spec.title: Dropped Publications
spec.description: Number of dropped metric publications due to system issues.

spec.title: Average Load
spec.description: Average load across all RegionServers in the cluster (avg number of region per RegionServer)

spec.title: RegionServers Availability
spec.description: Percentage of live RegionServers relative to the total number of RegionServers.

spec.title: Unknown Server Regions
spec.description: Number of regions assigned to unknown or unreachable servers.

spec.title: Unknown Server Open Regions
spec.description: Number of open regions assigned to unknown servers.

spec.title: IPC (Inter-Process Communication) Performance ,Monitors HBase RPC (Remote Procedure Call) comm between clients, RegionServers and the Master
